notes:
{文法|ぶんぽう} refers to grammar, the rules governing language structure.

- {文法|ぶんぽう}を{勉強|べんきょう}する: to study grammar

- {文法|ぶんぽう}が{正|ただ}しい: grammatically correct
- {文法|ぶんぽう}に{合|あ}う: to be grammatical
